title: Vial Smasher — Jekyll/Hyde
summary: Partner group slug: feed the table extra cards, then charge for every draw and every wheel discard.

tags.name: group slug
tags.reason: Sheoldred, Nekusar, Underworld Dreams, Razorkin Needlehead, Fate Unraveler, Kederekt Parasite, Scrawling Crawler, and Spiteful Visions tax every extra card; that tax is the clock.

tags.name: wheels
tags.reason: Windfall, Magus of the Wheel, Jace's Archivist, Dark Deal, Burning Inquiry, Wheel and Deal, and Molten Psyche are burst turns that fire every slug and discard payoff at once.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: Howling Mine, Font of Mythos, Kami, Dictate of Kruphix, Temple Bell, Folio of Fancies, and Forced Fruition exist to make opponents draw more than they want.

tags.name: group hug
tags.reason: The extra-draw package is real and symmetric; it is bait for the slug, not a gift deck, but opponents do get the cards.

tags.name: discard
tags.reason: Wheels plus Liliana's Caress, Waste Not, Bone Miser, and Sangromancer are a dedicated discard-payoff package.

tags.name: lifedrain
tags.reason: Caress, Sheoldred, Scrawling Crawler, Stormfist Crusader, and Sangromancer convert draws and discards into life loss and gain.

tags.name: voltron
tags.reason: Ishai grows from opponents casting spells and can close with commander damage, but the list is not equipment or aura voltron.

tags.name: alternate wincon
tags.reason: Laboratory Maniac and Court of Cunning mill are backups, not the primary plan.

tags.name: mill
tags.reason: Court of Cunning, Folio of Fancies, Syr Konrad, and Breach the Multiverse mill as a supporting axis.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Vial Smasher picks the burn target at random; that is incidental chaos, not a chaos deck.
